deal.product_description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra is a premium 47mm LTE Titanium smartwatch designed for both style and functionality. It features a circular display made with durable materials suitable for outdoor activities, providing GPS tracking, health monitoring, and custom apps for various needs. The robust design integrates a range of smart features including notifications, music control, and heart rate tracking, making it an ideal companion for fitness enthusiasts and tech-savvy users alike.

The Refurbished Unlocked Apple iPhone 14 Pro Max offers an impressive 256GB storage and a huge display, perfect for both media consumption and productivity. Enjoy advanced camera technology for stunning photos. This model is designed to provide a seamless user experience with 5G capabilities for faster downloads and streaming. Refurbished to high standards, it comes in various colors and can support all the latest apps from the App Store, accommodating any Apple enthusiast's needs.

A refurbished 10.9-inch iPad Air featuring the Apple M1 processor and 256GB of storage. It offers a high-resolution display, WiFi connectivity with USB-C, and comes with a battery health rating of 90% or higher capacity, backed by a one-year warranty.
Samsung Galaxy S26 Android smartphone with a 6.3-inch 2340x1080 AMOLED display, 12GB RAM, and 256GB storage. It features a 50MP rear camera and runs on Android 16.

A 75-inch TCL 75S571G 4K UHD LED Smart TV equipped with Dolby Vision, HDR10+, and HLG support for enhanced visual contrast. It features the TCL AIPQ Processor with AI picture optimization, Motion Rate 240 with MEMC frame insertion, Dolby Atmos audio, and Google TV platform with built-in Chromecast.

Refurbished and unlocked Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra smartphone featuring a large 6.8-inch display, powerful 108MP camera system, under-display fingerprint sensor, and ample storage with 256GB capacity and 12GB RAM. This unit is graded in Very Good condition, works on any carrier, and includes a one-year Allstate warranty.
Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra, a large 14.6-inch tablet with 256GB of storage capacity. This high-end tablet represents the premium option in the Samsung Galaxy lineup available in this selection.

Refurbished Samsung Galaxy S22 smartphone in good condition, featuring a 6.1-inch display, 50MP camera, 128GB storage, and 8GB of RAM. This device is unlocked for use with any compatible carrier and includes a one-year Allstate warranty.

Refurbished unlocked Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra with 256GB storage in good condition. Features a 6.8-inch 1440x3088 resolution 120Hz display, Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 processor, 8GB RAM, and a 5000mAh battery. Includes a 200MP main camera and a 12MP front camera.

A smart bird feeder featuring a built-in solar panel to power a 4000mAh rechargeable battery, equipped with a 2.5K HD camera (5MP resolution) and a 130-degree wide-angle lens for live streaming via 2.4GHz WiFi. It includes AI technology to identify over 10,000 bird species and send phone alerts, along with a 1.6-liter food reservoir, an integrated bird bath, perches, and local or cloud video storage options.

Monster 60W True Wireless Bluetooth Speaker featuring Bluetooth 5.4 with a 33-foot range, IPX8 waterproof rating suitable for pools and beach use, built-in microphone, TF card slot, touch controls, and dual pairing capability for 120W stereo sound output.
